## Unity Project Architecture Report: Character Death & Camera Switching System

### 1. PLAYER/CHARACTER SYSTEM

**Core files:**
- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Character/PlayerController.cs` — Base player class (MonoBehaviour). Key methods:
  - `Awake()` — Creates `AttributePlayerBase` (stats container) and `PlayerInputHandler`
  - `Start()` — Applies runes, sets up Rigidbody, calls `SetAndChangeHPUI()`
  - `Update()` — Calls `HandleInput()` + `HealthRecover()` (only if owner and in game scene)
  - `FixedUpdate()` — Calls `MoveCharacter()` (physics movement)
  - `OnDamageReceived(DamageEventArgs)` — Processes incoming damage, calls `attributePlayer.Damage()`, triggers HP UI update + RPC `NoticeOtherPlayerDamage` to other clients
  - `HealthRecover()` — Passive HP regen (skips if `isDead` or HP full)
  - `SetAndChangeHPUI()` — Fires `hpChangedChannel` event + RPC to others
  - `OnEnable/OnDisable` — Registers/unregisters with PlayerManager, event listeners; cleans up spawn point on destroy

## Unity Project Architecture Report: Character Death & Camera Switching System

### 1. PLAYER/CHARACTER SYSTEM

**Core files:**
- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Character/PlayerController.cs` — Base player class (MonoBehaviour). Key methods:
  - `Awake()` — Creates `AttributePlayerBase` (stats container) and `PlayerInputHandler`
  - `Start()` — Applies runes, sets up Rigidbody, calls `SetAndChangeHPUI()`
  - `Update()` — Calls `HandleInput()` + `HealthRecover()` (only if owner and in game scene)
  - `FixedUpdate()` — Calls `MoveCharacter()` (physics movement)
  - `OnDamageReceived(DamageEventArgs)` — Processes incoming damage, calls `attributePlayer.Damage()`, triggers HP UI update + RPC `NoticeOtherPlayerDamage` to other clients
  - `HealthRecover()` — Passive HP regen (skips if `isDead` or HP full)
  - `SetAndChangeHPUI()` — Fires `hpChangedChannel` event + RPC to others
  - `OnEnable/OnDisable` — Registers/unregisters with PlayerManager, event listeners; cleans up spawn point on destroy
  - Has `[SerializeField] protected GameObject virtualCamera` — a Cinemachine VC reference
  - Has `isOnlyShow` flag — when true, disables input and gravity (display-only character)
  - **CRITICAL: No death state machine or death handling exists.** The `AttributePlayerBase.isDead` flag is set by `Damage()` when HP≤0, but PlayerController never checks `isDead` after taking damage. There is no Die state, no respawn trigger, no camera switch on death.

- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Character/AttributePlayerBase.cs` — Pure data class (NOT MonoBehaviour). Fields: `isDead`, `attackPower`, `defensePower`, `criticalMultiplier`, `criticalChance`, `maxHealth`, `currentHealth`, `moveSpeed`, `attackInterval`, `healthRecover`, `maxAttackCount`, `comboCount`, `currentElement`, etc. `Damage(float)` subtracts HP; if `currentHealth <= 0` it only sets `currentHealth = 0` (no auto `isDead=true`). `isDead` is only set via `SetIsDead()`.

- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Character/WizardBoy.cs` — Subclass of PlayerController. Element switching (Grass/Winter/Lightning), card effects, pool initialization.
- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Character/BingNv.cs` — Another PlayerController subclass (not fully read, but follows same pattern).
- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Character/LittleRedGirl.cs` — Third character template.

- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Player/PlayerManager.cs` — Singleton (DontDestroyOnLoad). Manages: `Dictionary<string, PlayerData>` (all players), `List<GameObject> activePlayerObjects` (cache for enemy targeting), `AttributeCacheService`. Methods: `RegisterPlayerObject()`, `SyncAllPlayers()`, `GetLocalPlayer()`, `GetOtherPlayersIds()`, `IsLocalPlayer()`. Subscribes to `OnPlayerEnteredRoom/OnPlayerLeftRoom/OnLocalJoinedRoom` from PhotonPlayerService.

- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Player/PlayerData.cs` — Simple serializable class: `PlayerId (string)`, `PlayerName (string)`.

**Enemy death pattern (reference for player death design):**
- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Enemy/EnemyBase.cs` — Full state machine: Idle→Run→Attack→Die. `EnterDie()` disables colliders, stops physics, triggers animator `"die"` trigger, drops experience, invokes `ReturnToPool()` after 3s. `IsDeadOrDying()` checks both `isDead` flag AND `EnemyState.Die` state.
- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Enemy/AttackableEnemy.cs` — Extends EnemyBase with NavMeshAgent pathfinding and LOD optimization.
- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Character/AttributeEnemyBase.cs` — `Die()` method calls `SetIsDie(true)`. `TakeDamage()` calls `Die()` when `currentHealth <= 0`.

---

### 2. CAMERA SYSTEM

**Core files:**
- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Network/LocalCameraActivator.cs` — The **only** camera activation script. Inherits `MonoBehaviourPun`. On `Start()`:
  - If `photonView.IsMine`: activates `virtualCamera.gameObject` and enables `PlayerController`
  - If NOT mine: deactivates virtualCamera and disables PlayerController
  - The camera is on a child GameObject (sibling of "Player" under root prefab)

- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/LobbyVCamera.cs` — Manual orbit camera for lobby scene. Uses `MobileInputHelper` for drag input. Orbits around a `lookAt` target at fixed distance (3f). Listens to `changeCanRotateChannel` for rotation blocking.

- **No camera switching logic exists.** There is no CameraManager, no camera stack, no spectator camera.
- **No camera follow logic in code** — The follow is configured via Cinemachine Virtual Camera components in the prefab (not in C# scripts). The VC likely uses a "Follow" binding to the player Transform set in the prefab/Inspector.

- **Cinemachine usage is confirmed** via `using Cinemachine` in PlayerController.cs and LocalCameraActivator.cs (which uses `CinemachineVirtualCamera`). The Cinemachine package is imported (see Cinemachine.csproj.lscache).

- The camera architecture is: **one VC per player prefab instance, activated only for the local owner**. This means to implement a death camera switch, you would either (a) reparent/retarget an existing VC, or (b) create a new spectator VC that follows a teammate.

---

### 3. MULTIPLAYER/NETWORKING (Photon PUN 2)

**Core files:**
- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Network/Launcher.cs` — Central network orchestrator. Inherits `MonoBehaviourPunCallbacks`. Singleton (DontDestroyOnLoad). Handles:
  - Room creation (`MaxPlayers = 4`, `PublishUserId = true`)
  - Auto-room creation on connect (`"Room_" + random 1000-9999`)
  - Scene loading via `PhotonNetwork.LoadLevel()` (MasterClient only)
  - `OnPlayerPropertiesUpdate()` — Routes Ready/Loaded/SpawnPoint property changes
  - `OnPlayerLeftRoom()` — Delegates to SpawnPointManager
  - `QuitToMainMenu()` — Leave room + load scene 0
  - `SwitchCharacter()` — delegates to SpawnPointManager

- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Network/PhotonPlayerService.cs` — Implements `INetworkPlayerService`. Wraps Photon player operations: `IsOwnerOf()`, `IsMasterClient`, `IsConnectedAndInRoom`, `GetLocalActorNumber()`, `SetCustomProperty()`, `GetAllActorNumbers()`, events: `OnPlayerEnteredRoom`, `OnPlayerLeftRoom`, `OnLocalJoinedRoom`, `OnPlayerPropertyChanged`.

- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Network/PhotonObjectService.cs` — Network object instantiation (PhotonNetwork.Instantiate), viewID lookups, RPC dispatch.

- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Network/PhotonCallbackBridge.cs` — Bridges PUN callbacks to PhotonPlayerService (decoupling PUN from domain).

- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Network/DomainRpcBridge.cs` — **Centralized RPC handler**. All `[PunRPC]` methods live here. Key RPCs relevant to death/camera:
  - `NoticeOtherPlayerDamage(string playerId, float maxHP, float currentHP)` — Syncs other player HP to UI
  - `RPC_RequestEnemyDestroy(int viewID)` — Non-master requests enemy destroy
  - `InvokeRPC(methodName, NetworkTarget, params)` — Generic RPC dispatch via its PhotonView

- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Network/NetworkSceneFlow.cs` — Scene flow coordinator (non-MonoBehaviour, held by Launcher). Handles: ready check (`CheckAllPlayersReady()`), level loading (`LoadLevelAfterDelay()`), all players loaded check, return to lobby (`ReturnToLobby()`).

- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Network/SpawnPointManager.cs` — Player spawning logic. Key methods: `SpawnPlayer()` (PhotonNetwork.Instantiate at spawn point), `RespawnCharacter()` (destroy + re-instantiate at same spawn point), `SwitchCharacter()`, `ClearLocalPlayerSpawnPoint()`.

- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Network/PlayerPropertyKeys.cs` — Static keys: `PlayerReady`, `PlayerLoaded`, `PlayerLevel`, `CurrentSpawnPoint`, `playerName`.

- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Services/INetworkPlayerService.cs` — Interface for player network operations.
- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Services/INetworkObjectService.cs` — Interface for object network operations.

**RPC Patterns:**
- All RPCs go through `DomainRpcBridge.Instance`'s PhotonView
- `NetworkTargetMapper` converts domain `NetworkTarget` enum to `RpcTarget`
- Pattern: `NetworkServiceLocator.DomainRpcService.InvokeRPC("MethodName", NetworkTarget.X, args...)`
- Player damage broadcast: `NoticeOtherPlayerDamage` is called from `PlayerController.SetAndChangeHPUI()` targeting `NetworkTarget.Others`

**Player Spawning Flow:**
1. `Launcher.OnJoinedRoom()` → `SpawnPointManager.CreatedOrJoinedRoom()`
2. `SpawnPointManager.SpawnPlayer()` → deterministic spawn point by `actorNumber`, then `PhotonNetwork.Instantiate()`
3. Player prefab has PhotonView → `LocalCameraActivator.Start()` activates camera for owner
4. `PlayerController.OnEnable()` registers with `PlayerManager`

**Team System:**
- **No team assignment exists.** The game is cooperative PvE (all players vs enemies).
- `TeamUIManager` only shows other players' HP bars in a fixed 3-slot UI panel.
- `TeamUIManager.SetOtherTeamUI()` dynamically shows/hides player slots based on `PlayerManager.PlayerCount`.
- No "team mate" tracking beyond the HP bar binding in `TeamUIManager`.

---

### 4. INPUT SYSTEM

**Core files:**
- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/Input/PlayerInputHandler.cs` — **Legacy Input Manager wrapper** (NOT Unity Input System). Pure C# class held by PlayerController. Properties: `Horizontal`, `Vertical` (from VirtualJoystick or `Input.GetAxis`), `MousePosition`, keyboard keys (`Escape`, `Return`, `Tab`), mouse/touch (`IsMouseButtonDown/Up/Held` via `MobileInputHelper`). Has `static VirtualJoystick ActiveJoystick` reference.

- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/Input/VirtualJoystick.cs` — Mobile joystick. Implements `IPointerDownHandler/IDragHandler/IPointerUpHandler`. Registers itself as `PlayerInputHandler.ActiveJoystick` in `Awake()`. Uses `RectTransformUtility` for position calculation, supports dead zone.

- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/Input/MobileInputHelper.cs` — Unified input for touch/mouse. Methods: `GetPointerDown()`, `GetPointerUp()`, `GetPointerHeld()`, `GetScreenPosition()`.

- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/Input/InputUpdater.cs` — Additional input updater (not fully read).

**Input Flow:**
1. `PlayerController.Update()` → `HandleInput()` → `playerInputHandler.Update()` (reads axes/buttons)
2. Movement vector stored in `movementData.movementDirection`
3. `FixedUpdate()` → `MoveCharacter()` applies velocity to Rigidbody

---

### 5. DEATH & SPECTATOR — CURRENT STATE (NONE)

**Critical finding: There is NO existing spectator mode, camera switching, or player death handling.**

Evidence:
- Searching for "spectator|spectate|observe|switch.*camera|death.*camera" across all scripts found **zero matches** beyond a comment in SpawnPoint.cs about `IPunObservable`.
- `PlayerController` has no death state. After `attributePlayer.Damage()` reduces HP, no check for `isDead` exists in the damage handler. The `isDead` flag only gates `HealthRecover()`.
- No `Die()`, `OnDeath()`, `HandleDeath()`, or similar method exists in any player script.
- `MatchResultPanel.cs` exists for match results UI but is not tied to player death.
- Boss death exists (`GameManager.OnBossDeath()` — triggers 10s delayed lobby transition), but not player death.

**What needs to be built for character death + camera switching:**
1. A death state in PlayerController (disable input/movement, trigger death animation, disable collider)
2. A spectator camera system that finds the nearest living teammate and switches the local VC to follow them
3. RPC notification to other players when a teammate dies
4. Logic to handle "all players dead" → match end
5. Optional respawn timer or permanent death until boss kill/match end

---

### KEY CONNECTION POINTS (for designing the solution)
